careInstructions.x-anticipatedNote: ESPR Art. 7(2)(b)(ii) use and maintenance information, pending a delegated act. No EU instrument mandates care labelling: ISO 3758 is a standard, GINETEX symbols are industry IP, and Reg. (EU) 1007/2011 mentions care labels only in its Art. 24 review clause.

installationInstructionsUrl.title: Installation Instructions URL
installationInstructionsUrl.x-citationNote: GPSR Art. 9(7) requires the product to be ACCOMPANIED by clear instructions and safety information, and only where it cannot be used safely without them. The duty attaches to what accompanies the product; a URL in a passport is one compliant way to meet it, not a separate obligation. Verified against the EUR-Lex text.

safetyWarnings.x-citationNote: GPSR requires warnings accompany the product where its risks require them; it is not unconditional.

supplyChainActors.title: Supply Chain Actors
supplyChainActors.description: Key supply chain actors involved in production (tiered)
supplyChainActors.x-citationNote: ESPR Art. 9(2) does NOT mandate this datum. It tells the Commission what a DELEGATED ACT must specify — 'the requirements related to the digital product passport laid down in the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 4 shall … specify the following: (a) the data to be included …'. No furniture/textile delegated act is adopted, so nothing here is legally required yet. Anticipated under the coming act; voluntary today. Verified against the EUR-Lex text.

dueDiligenceStatementUrl.title: Due Diligence Statement URL
dueDiligenceStatementUrl.description: URL to due diligence statement per EUDR or CSDDD
dueDiligenceStatementUrl.x-citationNote: EUDR 2023/1115 requires a due-diligence STATEMENT submitted to the EU information system (Art. 4/33), and CSDDD 2024/1760 is a corporate-conduct duty on large undertakings — neither requires a per-product passport link. Voluntary transparency; note CSDDD does not bind an SME manufacturer at all.
